system.description:
You are skilled at wielding an unusual weapon with ease, allowing you to utilize it in combat more effectively.

Prerequisite: Base Attack Bonus +1

Effect: Select a single weapon from either the Exotic Weapons (Melee) or Exotic Weapons (Ranged) weapon groups; you make attack rolls with the selected weapon without penalty.

Normal: A character who uses a weapon without being proficient with it takes a -5 penalty to attack rolls.

Special: You can gain this Feat multiple times. Each time you take this Feat, it applies to a different Exotic Weapon.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook
